goals.1: Talking in a clothes shop: Ich suche …, Was ist Ihre Größe?
goals.3: passen and gefallen — fitting and liking
dialog.1.de.3.n: die Jacke + ein → eine blaue Jacke (ending -e)
dialog.3.de.1.n: Größe haben = to be a certain size
dialog.4.de.5.n: Colours are capitalised when used as nouns: in Blau = in blue
dialog.6.de.1.n: gefallen: „sie gefällt mir“ = I like it
dialog.6.de.2.n: mir = the Dativ form of ich
grammar.1.title: Adjectives before a noun: endings -e, -en, -es
grammar.1.intro: After ist the adjective does not change (Die Jacke ist blau). But before a noun, after ein, an ending is added:
grammar.1.note: Rule: the die-group takes -e, the der-group -en, the das-group -es. For now it is enough to recognise this table — more details at the next level.
grammar.2.title: Dativ pronouns — with passen, gefallen, helfen
grammar.2.note: Die Jacke gefällt mir. Die Hose passt dir gut. — The person who likes it or whom it fits is always in the Dativ.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order to make the question: “What is your size?”
